answer: Require every new identity to complete a verifiable useful task before it can transact — a willow cutting only counts once it has actually rooted. Each additional identity faces a steeper task, so the work an attacker must do follows a spiral upward while one honest agent pays once. Fakes that never finish real work stay locked out, and a mesa of idle identities earns nothing, making mass forgery cost more than any profit it could steal.
